zh.title: 聯合航空713架飛機已裝 Starlink 支線機佔352架
zh.summary: 聯合航空11月19日公布，已有713架飛機裝設 Starlink，約佔機隊47%。公司仍以2027年底完成全機隊安裝為目標。
body: 聯合航空11月19日更新機上網路進度，已為713架飛機安裝 Starlink，約佔機隊47%。其中有352架支線客機、353架窄體客機和8架寬體客機。
按機型來看，追蹤頁所列100架 CRJ-550 和252架 E175 均已完成安裝。窄體機隊中，波音737有211架、737 MAX 有71架，空中巴士 A321 另有71架完成安裝。
聯合航空仍以2027年底完成全機隊安裝為目標。旅客可在出發前3天內，用航班編號和日期在聯航網站查詢是否提供 Starlink。

en.title: United installs Starlink on 713 aircraft, including 352 regional jets
en.summary: United’s November 19 update puts Starlink installation at 47% of its fleet. The airline still targets completion by the end of 2027.
body: United Airlines reported Starlink installations on 713 aircraft in its November 19 update, covering 47% of the fleet. The total comprised 352 regional aircraft, 353 narrowbodies and eight widebodies.
United’s tracker lists all 100 CRJ-550s and all 252 E175s as equipped. Among narrowbodies, it shows 211 Boeing 737s, 71 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft and 71 Airbus A321s with installations completed.
United is still targeting the end of 2027 for fleetwide installation. Passengers can use its tracker to look up availability by flight number and date up to three days before departure.
